ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Funding in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential cut in Medicaid funding in Minnesota and its impact on the state's healthcare system
questions: What is the current state of Medicaid funding in Minnesota?
How would a cut in funding affect the state's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with the state's healthcare system and the impact of funding cuts on vulnerable populations.
